items.q: He was White, yeah. He could blow, too. Oh, he was sensational.

ctx.x: He was White, yeah. He could blow, too. Oh, he was sensational. Charlie, Charlie, Charlie... In fact, I think Lena Horne worked with him. Either her or Billie Holiday. Geez, how could I forget anybody's name? Charlie, Charlie... A tenor player...
Well, we can come back to it.
